$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Symbols: Material + Tabler + Fluent
blocks.licence: Apache-2.0 (Google Material Symbols, outlines made from the icon font of @vostok/fonts); MIT (Tabler Icons filled; Microsoft Fluent Emoji High Contrast), licence texts beside the data
blocks.for: Every symbol a customer can put in a design, three sets under one id (material:, tabler:, fluent:), one set of categories and one search; older ids still resolve. Shown through the Symbol chooser.

blocks.name: Symbol shapes
blocks.for: Any symbol of the library as closed shapes in millimetres (islands that never cross or overlap, centred, Y up), its drawing from the same shapes, and whether it prints as one solid blob.

blocks.name: Old symbol codes
blocks.for: What older codes become in the symbol library: Name Keychain's Font Awesome characters, and the Lucide names the clicker and keycap shortlist.
